notes.title: [REFUGE]Major Update Announcement
notes.content:
The next update will add a lot of new gameplay and content, and, more importantly, will fix all the main problems of the game, such as:
[list]
[*] Bosses who have one attack - In new update, bosses will not spam a one attack
[*] Enemy spawn dynamics - Which didn’t allow you to dive into the action and constantly reset the game dynamics, now it will work not so
[*] Disbalance of turrets - In new update, shoulder turrets will have their own ammunition and characteristics
[*] Game balance - In new update, the difficulty of the game will increase gradually, which will affect: HP of the bosses, the cost of chests, the damage of enemies
[*] The lack of controller support - Partial will be added
[/list]

And these are just the main fixes. You will see the rest soon when the update is released.
Thank you to all those who expressed their feedback ;)

notes.title: Soon Update - World Events System
notes.content:
In the near future, the game will have a system of events that will temporarily put the world of the game in new conditions. For example, there will be such events as: meteor shower, earthquake, attack of the troll king, etc.

This system should add some shake to the gameplay. I hope you like this idea)

notes.title: [REFUGE]Upcoming update
notes.content:
I got some reviews about the game at the moment. And I came to the conclusion that people would like to see more interactive objects on the map, as well as improving the combat system, but it is not yet clear what exactly you would like to see in terms of improving the combat system. In any case, in the next update, the world will be filled, and new mechanics will be introduced.

If you want to add something to the game, and enter something that is missing - write here in the comments. I will answer for sure. :)
